about: RX 9070, 16 GB, on a ROCm torch. SCAIL-2 at fp8 does not fit beside everything else, so it loads as a Q5_K_M GGUF, and both text encoders run on the CPU. Launch ComfyUI with: python main.py --reserve-vram 1 --use-pytorch-cross-attention (add --disable-dynamic-vram if the GGUF loader misbehaves). Nothing has been drawn on it yet.
